capabilities: Expand wikilinks into editable inline note bodies
Create linked notes inline via a plus icon or Tab
Collapse and expand inline notes with a chevron control
Nest inline notes up to five levels deep
Style nesting with accent lines or cards
disambiguation: Not embeds or virtual notes; each inline note is a real Markdown file in the vault, only edited in place.
extras: The manifest description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is manual (download release files into the plugins folder); the feedback section appears to reuse text from the author's other plugin, Never Leave the Graph View.
problem: Clicking through a wikilink opens a blank note and pulls you out of the context you were writing in.

relations.evidence: Use together with my Never Leave the Graph View plugin: make inline notes directly in the graph preview pane

summary: Link expander that turns any wikilink into an editable, collapsible note body inline, without leaving the current note.
